scope: Account-free comparison of actual Preview guest QPC with host clocks
method: Guest samples QPC before request and after native host acknowledgement; native host samples clocks between those guest samples
limitations: Cross-process round-trip brackets establish clock domain/epoch, not sub-microsecond calibration accuracy
Prior native Metal domain probe establishes sampled GPU nanoseconds versus 24 MHz counter ticks; conversion still needs integration validation
No game latency display or input-to-display measurement acceptance
